newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Huaneng underwritten for $500 mln.
newsitem.headline: China's Huaneng underwritten for $500 mln.

text.p: Leading Chinese property insurer People's Insurance (Property) Co has underwritten a policy for $500 million to transport freight for the Huaneng International Power Development Corp, the China Daily said on Wednesday.
People's Insurance will insure transport of imported equipment to be used for power projects in Nantong in booming eastern Jiangsu province and in Fuzhou in southeastern Fujian province, it said.

The insurer has already provided cover for freight transport, machine damage, all risk for project installation and property insurance. The accumulated insurance has exceeded $10 billion, including insurance for transport alone of $4.26 billion, the newspaper said.
